correctness.rationale: For even m,n>=4 and N=mn/2, F_2 full torus adjacency factors as X^(-1)(1+XY)(1+XY^(-1)). Each diagonal translation has g=gcd(m,n) orbits; because g is even every intersection of the two orbit families has even cardinality, so ker(1+XY) subset im(1+XY^-1). Nullity full adjacency =2g and bipartite block form gives rank(B)=N-g. Direct character orthogonality of the graph-state amplitudes gives exactly 2^rank(B) equal Schmidt eigenvalues. Every bipartite color degree is four, so B1=0 and 1^T B=0. For any edge uv, B_e=B+e_u e_v^T: adjusting preimage by the all-ones vector proves im(B) subset im(B_e), and B_e 1=e_u outside im(B), hence rank exactly +1. This sign-specific proof applies to even-degree bipartite graphs; group-state Schmidt negativity and Rényi consequences follow from a flat spectrum.
